name: Onbashira Kirito
source:
A 14 year old genius inventor whose forte is creating magical tools from junk. He's a cheerful and expressive boy who is weak around girls. Raised in the church as an orphan like Munakata.

Since he is not yet an official exorcist, he is in charge of information management, tool repair, and maintenance.

[Translated from [url=http://maria.karin-e.jp/dc/02_chara/06.htm]official website[/url]]
